standard_prerequisites.use: Identifies the epimorphism property used for the constructed maps.

standard_prerequisites.name: A coequalizer presentation from two epimorphisms
standard_prerequisites.use: Turns an epimorphism onto the fibre product of the first map with itself into a coequalizer presentation.

core_obligations: The first epimorphism (proof lines 2676-2685): the author takes the coproduct of the representable sheaves of the members of the chosen family indexed by their sections, and the map sending the identity of a member to the corresponding section; the condition on the family together with the characterisation of epimorphisms shows that this map is an epimorphism.

The second epimorphism and the presentation (proof lines 2686-2689): applying the same construction to the fibre product of the first map with itself produces the second epimorphism, and the companion result turns the pair into a coequalizer presentation of the sheaf.
proof_roadmap: Construct an epimorphism onto the sheaf from a coproduct of representables indexed by sections.
Apply the same construction to the fibre product of that map with itself.
Use the companion result to obtain the coequalizer presentation.
difficulty_reason: The lemma states that a sheaf of sets on a site admits a presentation as a coequalizer of a diagram whose terms are coproducts of representable sheaves of members of a family that covers every object (statement lines 2657-2673). The proof is a complete construction: the author forms the coproduct of the representable sheaves indexed by the sections of the sheaf over the members of the family and checks that the natural map is an epimorphism using the characterisation of epimorphisms and the covering condition (proof lines 2676-2685); the same construction applied to the fibre product of that map with itself gives the second term (proof lines 2686-2688); and the companion result converts this data into the coequalizer presentation (proof lines 2688-2689). The non-formal content is the construction and the epimorphism check. The claim is H2: a construction with each input named.
